description: FREE. Opt-in: ask the user for a spending budget enforced on NEAR (Saku) instead of paying from a wallet key that can spend everything in it. Makes a NEAR key for this agent on this machine (the private half never leaves it) and returns a link. The user opens it, sets the limits and the sellers, and confirms one transaction in their own NEAR wallet; call this tool again afterwards to check, then restart the MCP client. From then on payments go through the user's allowance contract, which signs only within their rules, so a stolen agent key is worth one day's budget at most. Trade-off to tell the user: each payment then takes ~15-20 s (NEAR’s MPC network signs it), and one over the limits or to a new seller waits for their approval. Testnet unless network is "mainnet".

name.description: Short name for the allowance: a-z, 0-9 and dashes, 2-24 long. Default: a random one.
